name: dsh-plugin-opencode-go
description: Host-side OpenCode Go adapter for DeepSeek Harness: session-partitioned request headers on every Go request, priority-based multi-key selection with session affinity and failover, a Go-native web_search provider with automatic model fallback, and a web_fetch provider that works behind fake-ip / transparent proxies
author: mikoto

scripts.test: node test/mechanism.test.mjs && node test/fetch.test.mjs && node test/keys.test.mjs
